dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Whoa! I can buy my favorite novel!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe I should save it up?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: I'm gonna do that! Thanks, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Have you forgotten what your allowance is for?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It's for spending... On a brand-new Genius Invokation deck!

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: Genius Invokation: A champion walks the road to victory!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Remind me which of us is champion again?
